I'm

blood is on my hands I
[G]stare at my reflection I

I

[Bm]hear the sirens coming I
see the flashing lights I'm

Wearing my disguise I
[D]show up at her doorstep To
look her in the eyes I
[F#]tell her that it's me But she
doesn't recognize

one I killed is me
